description: TXN-CLOSE, the discriminator the first card left untested: the recordset (and clone) are opened BEFORE BeginTrans and closed inside the level, as in r-fix-cat-txn/clone-close-*. Seven variants, each on its own Workspace and row (the seventh on Workspaces(0), as the old probes): (1) dynaset opened before, Close inside; (2) dynaset before, Edit/Update inside, Close; (3) dynaset and clone before, Edit/Update on the original inside, Close the clone; (4) dynaset and clone before, no edit, Close the original; (5) the same, Close the clone; (6) table-type before, Edit/Update inside, Close; (7) as (3) on Workspaces(0). After each Close: Errors before/after, then Rollback with Errors (3034 means the level had ended), then the row is read. A fresh Workspace reads all rows. Asks whether opening before the level is what makes Close raise 3246 and end the level.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
